title: Perturbation structure and imperfect physics in neural PDE forecasting
description: Code and archived evaluation results for controlled experiments on physics-generated training examples in neural PDE forecasting. The release includes 864 development fits across six equations and 720 follow-up fits for spatial-resolution checks and augmentation selection on two additional equations. Architectures are a standard transformer, a fixed-depth shared-block transformer, and a compact Fourier neural operator. The experiments examine perturbation structure and physical-model mismatch. The guarded selector improves on short-probe selection in the primary pooled comparison; its improvement over no augmentation is inconclusive. Synthetic systems only. Saved evaluation arrays, exact source snapshots, configurations, protocols, and reports are included; generated training trajectories and model checkpoints are regenerated by the runners. Version 1.0.0 is a research software and results release, not a journal acceptance or externally registered protocol.
